symptom: Exact-main production build failed after Dutch money-page copy changed while the versioned English cache still represented the previous source corpus.
root_cause: Public HTML copy and the production static-English cache were changed in separate delivery lineages; preview builds run offline and did not require provider fill, while production remained fail-closed.
prevention: Every public HTML copy change must update a versioned English cache or overlay in the same PR.
A targeted regression must prove the changed Dutch source strings have non-empty English translations.
Production remains fail-closed; do not weaken translation requirements to make deploys pass.
